jobs.description:
Work in an international IT environment where you’ll collaborate daily with engineers across Europe and take ownership of a diverse infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational and well-established organisationwith operations across several European locations. Its IT environment supports a diverse international workforce and relies on a collaborative team of engineers to keep everything running smoothly.

 

As aSenior System Engineer, you will join a small and technically versatile IT team, working closely with engineers and colleagues across different countries. This is not a role limited to ticket resolution: you will work across1st, 2nd and 3rd line support, infrastructure, cloud and systems administration, while contributing to the continuous improvement of the IT environment.
Senior System Engineer - Your Role
• Provide1st, 2nd & 3rd line support, troubleshooting a broad range of hardware, software, endpoint and infrastructure issues.
• Administer and maintainMicrosoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Windows and endpoint environments.
• Manage user lifecycle activities includingonboarding, offboarding and access management.
• Handleincidents, requests, problems and changeswithin an ITIL-based service environment, using Jira for ticket management.
• Work closely withinternational IT engineers, external providers and technical partnersto resolve issues and maintain service quality.
• Contribute toIT projects, process improvements, documentation and knowledge sharing, while providing technical backup to the wider team.
Senior System Engineer - Your Profile
• 5+ years of experienceas a System Engineer or Service Engineer or in a similar infrastructure-focused role.
• Strong hands-on knowledge ofMicrosoft 365, Azure and Windows environments.
• Solid experience across1st, 2nd and 3rd line support, with excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
• Comfortable working within anITIL-based environmentand usingJirafor IT service management.
• Strong communication skills and a genuineservice-oriented mindset; you enjoy working with people as much as solving technical challenges.
• Fluent English is essential; French and/or Dutch are a strong plus.

Build, improve and own IT systems in an international environment where every day brings a new technical challenge.

Our partner is aninternational organisationwith a lean and collaborative IT team supporting colleagues across several European locations.

What makes this role different?You won't be limited to one technical area.You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to a broad and international infrastructure, and have plenty of room to grow.

﻿They are looking for aSenior System Engineerwho enjoys variety, takes ownership and wants to keep developing technically.
Senior System Engineer - Role & Responsibilities
• Provide1st, 2nd & 3rd line support, troubleshooting issues across users, systems, endpoints and infrastructure.
• Administer and maintainMicrosoft 365, Entra ID, Azure and Windowsenvironments.
• Take ownership ofsystem maintenance, incidents, requests and changeswithin an ITIL-based framework.
• Manageuser lifecycle & access, including onboarding, offboarding and permissions.
• Drivedocumentation & knowledge sharing, using tools such as Jira and Confluence to keep the IT environment structured and up to date.
• Contribute totechnical projects & continuous improvement, while collaborating with colleagues and external IT partners across Europe.
Senior System Engineer - Profile & Technologies
• 5–15 years of experienceas a System Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Service Engineer or similar.
• Strong hands-on knowledge ofMicrosoft 365, Azure and Windowsenvironments.
• Solid experience across1st, 2nd and 3rd line supportand system administration.
• Practical knowledge ofITIL, Jira and Confluence, with a strong focus on technical documentation.
• Comfortable working in aninternational infrastructure, collaborating with users, IT colleagues and external providers.
• Fluent Englishis essential; Dutch is a strong advantage. French is a plus.

We are Team possible – the people behind Davinsi Labs, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Codit, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here!United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world. That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do. Sounds like your kind of place?

Your job

What can you expect from this role? 

You will be part of our MSP teams focusing on Managed Detection and Response (MDR). The SRE team focuses on the backend platformization and automation side of the MDR service. Aspects like reliability, scalability, automation and efficiency of our managed service provider (MSP) technology stack are extremely important for Davinsi Labs. Your primary objective as an engineer will be to continuously enhance these capabilities across different complex customer environments. Your expertise and performance will directly impact the experience of our valued clients. The most relevant technologies for the SRE team are the following ones: 

• AWS
• GitHub
• Nutanix Prism
• HashiCorp Terraform
• HashiCorp Vault
• HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)
• Ansible
• Microsoft Entra ID
• Microsoft Azure
• PingIdentity PingOne for customers
• Rocky Linux
Key responsibilities: 

• Design and implementation: You will be designing and implementing zero-touch production concepts across all levels of our MSP technology stack, leveraging applications Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Enterprise Security, Cribl Stream and Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR automation and orchestration capabilities to enhance operational efficiency. You will also be designing and implementing cloud infrastructure architecture, with a focus on AWS, Nutanix Prism, Microsoft Azure and Rocky Linux. This also includes IAM solutions, such as Single Sign-On (SSO), based on Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Automation: You'll develop automation capabilities for all value services, through CI/CD pipelines design and development.
• Version Control & Release Management: You'll be managing version control effectively using platforms such as GitHub. On the other hand, you'll be utilizing release management tools to streamline software deployment processes.
• Secret Management Solutions: Implementing secret management solutions like HashiCorp HCP Vault for MSP backends.
• Documentation: Generating and automating documentation using tools like Atlassian Confluence to ensure comprehensive system documentation. 

Your profile

 Hello, is it me you're looking for? 

• You have a strong background in computer science, computer engineering, or IT security (a degree is an asset).
• Experience with some of the following technologies: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Rocky Linux, Ansible, HashiCorp product portfolio, Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Experience with one or more of the following is highly recommended: Git, Atlassian Jira, Atlassian Confluence, Python v3, JavaScript.
• Affinity with threat detection platforms like SIEM technologies (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Stack, etc) and/or XDR technologies (Microsoft Defender XDR, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, etc) is an asset.
• You communicate in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. French is an asset.
• You are a problem solver with an analytical mind. As a team player with a positive attitude, you are always ready to challenge and to be challenged.

Job description
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you’ll drive the engineering and 
execution of major BESS projects (typically >100M EUR investment).
 

● You are responsible for overseeing multidisciplinary design across electrical, civil, 
and structural engineering domains..
 

● You supervise EPC partners, engineering firms, consultants, and other external 
stakeholders throughout all phases, and coordinate internal teams including 
development, procurement, construction, and HSE.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you prepare technical specifications 
and lead tendering processes with suppliers, integrators, and contractors..
 

● You manage key technical domains such as: BESS system architecture, HV/MV 
substations, grid interconnection, cabling, electrical infrastructure, civil works, site 
infrastructure, etc.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you closely follow the project 
planning, make adjustments where necessary, and report on the project progress 
and the milestones.

Your profile
 

● You have a Master degree in Engineering (Electrical, Industrial, Civil, …) or 
equivalent level of education.
 

● You have relevant experience in engineering or construction of large-scale energy or 
infrastructure projects (BESS or renewables preferred).
 

● Solid understanding of project development, permitting, and grid connection 
procedures.
 

● You have strong coordinating skills and are able of successfully managing all parties 
involved.
 

● Excellent knowledge of English and French, able to communicate in Dutch is a plus.
 

● You are communicative, have strong people skills and can take initiative.

• A driving licence is required!

Responsibilities

In this role as a Python ERP Developer, you take charge of the continuous evolution of internal business applications.

• Develop and refine custom features within the Odoo platform to streamline core operational processes.
• Connect software tools using clean API integrations and database structures to ensure accurate reporting.
• Troubleshoot technical issues quickly to maintain smooth daily workflows or coordinate with external development partners.
• Translate feedback from users in the field into clear technical specifications and practical solutions.
• Manage the internal reporting platform to guarantee overall system integration and data integrity.

 

     
Profile

For the position of Python ERP Developer, we are looking for a developer with a few years under their belt who combines analytical thinking with clear communication skills.

• Proven proficiency in Python and familiarity with other programming languages like .NET (ideally 2 to 4 years of experience in a similar role).
• Demonstrable experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP package is a major advantage.
• Colleagues describe you as a pragmatic problem solver who easily explains complex tech concepts to non-technical users.
• You speak English or French fluently, with at least a practical working knowledge of Dutch (or a strong willingness to learn).

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer | Mandarin & English | International group
jobs.description:
Are you a 
Finance professional with experience in Belgian accounting and a strong interest in an international environment? Do you speak 
Mandarin and English and enjoy acting as the link between different finance teams? Are you looking for a role where you can combine your accounting knowledge with 
international collaboration, communication and coaching?
 

 
 

You will join a 
dynamic international industrial group with activities across different markets and a strong presence in both Europe and Asia. Despite its international scale, the organisation maintains 
short communication lines and a personal, family-oriented approach. You will become an important link between the finance team in the 
Waregem region and the finance team in China, giving you a unique opportunity to work across cultures and finance environments.
 

 
 

About the company
 

The organisation is part of a 
large international industrial group with activities across multiple countries. The Belgian organisation operates in a 
dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged. You will work closely with colleagues in Belgium and China and play an important role in ensuring smooth communication between both finance teams.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You follow up on 
purchase and sales invoices, payments and outstanding items and ensure that the Belgian finance administration is processed accurately and on time. 
This gives you a hands-on role with direct ownership of important accounting processes. 

• You perform and monitor 
bank bookings and financial transactions, while keeping the accounting records accurate and up to date. 
You will further strengthen your practical accounting expertise within an international environment. 

• You act as the 
financial point of contact between the Belgian site and the finance team in China, translating questions, clarifying processes and ensuring that information flows smoothly between both locations. 
This gives you broad international exposure and allows you to build a strong network across two finance organisations. 

• You support and 
coach finance colleagues in China on Belgian accounting principles, processes and reporting requirements. 
You can use your own experience to help colleagues develop while simultaneously strengthening your communication and coordination skills. 

• You will occasionally 
travel to China to strengthen collaboration with the local finance team and support the alignment of processes. 
This offers you valuable international experience and the opportunity to work directly with colleagues on-site.  

 
 

Profile requirements as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You have practical experience within 
Belgian accounting and are familiar with 
BE GAAP. 

• You speak 
Mandarin Chinese and English fluently, allowing you to communicate effectively with both the Belgian and Chinese finance teams. 

• Knowledge of 
Dutch is a nice-to-have. 

• You are comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment. 

• You have a 
coordinating and communicative personality and enjoy acting as a bridge between different teams. 

• You are willing to 
travel to China occasionally as part of your role.

Are you passionate about SAP and eager to work in an innovative IT landscape with first-adopter technologies?

At Joris Ide, SAP plays a key role in supporting and optimising our business processes across Europe. As a SAP FICO Consultant, you contribute to third-line support, system enhancements and end-to-end projects, working closely with both IT and the business. Ready to make an impact? Ide-al!

What does your day look like?

• You research new SAP applications and functionalities to support business use cases.
• You build new processes and continuously optimise existing ones.
• You roll out the SAP template to new factories and countries.
• You work closely with business process owners and key stakeholders.
• You participate in blueprint and fit-gap analyses.
• You analyse and understand business processes and requirements and translate them into functional designs.
• You configure the system and write functional and technical specifications.
• You document and test new functionalities thoroughly.
• You support the business during acceptance testing and go-live.
• You play a key role throughout all project phases, from start to finish.
• You work with the latest SAP technologies, including SAP S/4HANA.

Who are we looking for?

• You have profound knowledge of SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling)
• You are familiar with business processes and their implementation in SAP
• You have strong analytical skills
• You have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
• You enjoy working in an informal, no-nonsense environment
• You work independently but collaborate easily with colleagues
• You are interested in a manufacturing environment
• You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe
• You speak English; knowledge of Dutch or French is a plus
• You are able to debug programming codePersoonsgebonden competenties (soft skills):
• Analyseren
• Communiceren
• Initiatief
• Plannen en organiseren
• Resultaatgerichtheid
• Samenwerken
